Title: Public Preview: Next-Gen Dashboards Experience in Azure Portal

Body.Content:
We're adding a new Dashboards experience within the Azure Portal. This new experience includes a richer editing experience, dashboard as a view, mobile support, and works in parallel with our current experience.

Currently, Dashboards are a focused and organized view of your cloud resources in the Azure portal. You can use dashboards as a workspace where you can monitor resources and quickly launch tasks for day-to-day operations. This new experience is accessible through the Dashboard Hub, the Browse experience, and in our Azure Mobile app. You can create your own dashboards or transform an existing dashboard into the new experience.

We will run the new and current experience in parallel to ensure parity and safely roll out new features for our new experience.
